card.essence: Profound prostration with anxious restlessness drives the patient from place to place despite extreme weakness. Burning pains paradoxically relieved by heat. Fastidious, fearful, and despairing, convinced of impending death. Characteristic midnight aggravation (1–2 am). Discharges are thin, acrid, putrid—cadaveric odours pervade. A remedy of malignant, gangrenous states and gradual wasting.

keynotes.text: Extreme anxiety, restlessness, fear of death; changing places continually despite exhaustion
Burning pains like fire or hot coals, paradoxically > heat
Great prostration; sudden sinking of vital forces; exhaustion from slightest exertion
Cadaveric aspect: pale, cold, clammy skin, putrid odours from all discharges
Intense thirst for cold water; drinks often but little at a time; water lies like stone in stomach
Midnight aggravation (1–2 am or 1–2 pm); periodicity marked
Cannot bear sight or smell of food
Fastidious, exacting, fault-finding; miserly and malicious
Thin, acrid, scanty secretions; excoriating discharges from all orifices
Must sit or bend forward; springs out of bed at night for air; fears suffocation

modalities_worse.text: Cold: cold air, cold drinks, cold food, ice-cream, ice-water
Lying on affected side or with head low
Vegetables, watery fruits, melons, alcoholic drinks, spoiled meat, bad sausage

modalities_better.text: Heat in general: hot applications, hot drinks, hot food, warm room
Head elevated, sitting erect with head raised by pillows
Headache temporarily > cold bathing (opposite of general)

mentals: Great anguish and anxious restlessness; changes place continually
Fear of death when alone or going to bed; thinks it useless to take medicine, is incurable
Despair drives from place to place; suicidal impulses
Attacks of anxiety at night driving out of bed, < after midnight
Hallucinations of smell and sight; delirium tremens with cursing and raving
physicals: Rapid emaciation; marasmus of affected parts
Cold, clammy sweat; body cold as ice externally with internal burning
Skin dry, scaly, rough, wrinkled like parchment; white and pasty or earth-coloured
Black vesicles; gangrenous inflammations; malignant pustules; anthrax
Anasarca; pale, waxy, puffy, baggy swelling; dropsy
Cannot lie down; must sit up or bend forward for air
Asthmatic breathing worse midnight; wheezing, whistling respiration
Haemorrhages of dark, offensive blood from any orifice
Diarrhoea scanty, dark, offensive; rice-water or small acrid burning stools
Vomiting and stool simultaneous; worse after eating or drinking
Headache relieved by cold (scalp sensitive, cannot brush hair)
Neuralgias > heat (face, eyes) but headache > cold
Albuminuria; Bright's disease; diabetes with gangrene
Periodicity: complaints return annually; paroxysms incomplete with exhaustion
clinical: Typhoid and septic fevers with cadaveric aspect, putrid odours, midnight aggravation
Malignant conditions: gangrenous pneumonia, diphtheria, erysipelas, epithelioma, scirrhus
Ptomaine poisoning; ill effects of decayed food, spoiled meat, dissecting wounds
Intermittent fevers after abuse of quinine; malarial cachexia
Asthma worse midnight; must sit up, fears suffocation; receding eruptions
Gastralgia from ice-cream, ice-water, vinegar, fruits; burning > hot drinks
Cholera with intense agony, prostration, burning thirst
Haemorrhoids burning like fire, relieved by heat
Skin affections: psoriasis, eczema with intense itching and burning, ulcers with putrid discharge
Infantile Kala-azar; degeneration; wasting in malignancy regardless of location
Hay-fever with thin, excoriating discharge; worse open air, better indoors
Gives quiet and ease in last moments of life when given in high potency

differentials.note: Aconite restless in early fever with high grade; Arsenic in later stages with prostration. Aconite tosses in agony; Arsenic too weak to toss, wants to be moved.
Both: tympanites, offensive clots, burning, prostration. Secale wants cold, uncovered, windows open. Arsenic wants heat, warmth, wrapping.
Both: fluent acrid coryza. Arsenic more burning, ameliorated by hot drinks; Cepa less burning modality.
Both: fluent coryza. Arsenic burnings > heat; often follows Mercurius if only partial relief.
Arsenic right-sided (esp. lung apex); burning > heat; chilly; restless weakness. Phosphorus left then right; burning desires cold; sympathetic.
Sulphur leads for burnings in chronic cases generally; Arsenic in acute/malignant states with prostration and periodicity.

cautions: Extensively abused in Old School as Fowler's solution
Do not prescribe in anticipation of malignant development; treat the case as it presents
After urinating, feeling of weakness in abdomen
Complaints return annually; inveterate neuralgias require constitutional follow-up
